newsitem.title: USA: Humana says waiting periods end for mergers.
newsitem.headline: Humana says waiting periods end for mergers.

text.p: Humana Inc said on Monday the waiting periods under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 relating to Humana's acquisitions of both Physician Corporation of America and ChoiceCare Corp have expired.
Humana had agreed to acquire Physician Corp for $7 per share plus the assumption of $130 million in debt, for a total consideration of approximately $400 million in cash.

In a separate deal, Humana announced its intention to acquire all of ChoiceCare's outstanding shares of common stock for $16.38 per share or a total consideration of approximately $250 million in cash.
